cards.headline: Integrating Heterogeneous Echocardiography AI Outputs in Language Space

source.title: Integrating Heterogeneous Echocardiography AI Outputs in Language Space: Learnable Late Fusion with a Supervised LLM
source.excerpt: These results suggest that a supervised LLM can combine multiple upstream models without model-specific output conversion or feature engineering that requires medical knowledge.

cards.headline: Non-Invasive Breast Cancer Receptor Typing from Mammograms Using Artificial Intelligence

source.title: Non-Invasive Breast Cancer Receptor Typing from Mammograms Using Artificial Intelligence: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
source.publisher: Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
source.excerpt: Priorities include larger multicenter cohorts, standardized pipelines, preregistered external validation, uncertainty quantification, and multimodal fusion.

cards.headline: Explainable Artificial Intelligence in Dentistry

source.title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence in Dentistry: A Systematic Review of Its Trust and Translation.
source.excerpt: Current dental XAI lacks the evidence quality required for clinical reliance. Practitioners should exercise caution, as these tools have not been proven to actually improve diagnostic accuracy or trust in daily practice. Until validated in real-world settings, XAI remains experimental technology rather than a standard of care.

cards.headline: Krefeld Pinguine

source.title: Krefeld Pinguine
source.excerpt: Die Krefeld Pinguine sind ein Krefelder Eishockey-Club, der die offizielle Bezeichnung KEV Pinguine Eishockey GmbH trägt. Der KEV war als Gründungsmitglied der Deutschen Eishockey Liga (DEL) von 1994 bis 2022 in der höchsten Spielklasse vertreten. Nach dem Abstieg in die DEL2 zur Saison 2022/23 kehrt der Verein zur Saison 2026/27 wieder in die DEL zurück.

cards.headline: Sparse Fine-Tuning for Parameter-Efficient Adversarial Training

source.title: Sparse Fine-Tuning for Parameter-Efficient Adversarial Training
source.excerpt: Across architectures and datasets, SAFT outperforms LoRA-based methods in both clean and robust accuracy with fewer trainable parameters, and approaches or surpasses full parameter AT in robustness while updating only about 5\% of parameters.

cards.headline: Impact of digital Tai Chi interventions on the physical and mental health of older adults

source.title: Impact of digital Tai Chi interventions on the physical and mental health of older adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Digital Tai Chi demonstrate significant advantages in promoting cognitive function and mental health in older adults, with high-interaction technologies providing more stable psychological benefits. However, in the dimension of physical function remodeling, digital Tai Chi currently exhibits efficacy comparable to traditional exercise, without generating significant incremental advantages.

cards.headline: Madrider Konferenz

source.title: Madrider Konferenz
source.excerpt: Die Friedenskonferenz von Madrid war ein Versuch der internationalen Gemeinschaft, einen Friedensprozess für den Nahostkonflikt in Gang zu bringen, indem Israel, Syrien, Libanon, Jordanien und die Palästinenser an den Verhandlungstisch geholt wurden. Sie wurde durch die Regierung Spaniens unter Mitwirkung der Vereinigten Staaten und der Sowjetunion abgehalten. Die Konferenz begann am 30.

cards.headline: ATLAS-Bench: An Agentic Tool-Use Benchmark for Local Area Search

source.title: ATLAS-Bench: An Agentic Tool-Use Benchmark for Local Area Search
source.excerpt: These results highlight the challenge of satisfying individual requirements while providing usable recommendations across queries.

cards.headline: Prognostic significance of tumoral Siglec-15 expression in solid tumors

source.title: Prognostic significance of tumoral Siglec-15 expression in solid tumors: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Elevated tumoral Siglec-15 expression was associated with unfavorable OS and DFS/RFS, whereas the borderline association with improved DSS should be interpreted cautiously because it was based on only three studies. These findings support a highly cancer-type dependent role of Siglec-15 as a clinically relevant prognostic biomarker and a promising immunotherapeutic target.

cards.headline: Ungarischer Volksaufstand

source.title: Ungarischer Volksaufstand
source.excerpt: Der Ungarische Volksaufstand bezeichnet die bürgerlich-demokratische Revolution und den Freiheitskampf von 1956 in der Volksrepublik Ungarn, bei denen sich breite gesellschaftliche Kräfte gegen die Regierung der kommunistischen Partei und der sowjetischen Besatzungsmacht erhoben.

cards.headline: Verifiable LLM-Guided Focal SMT Solving for Quantified Arrays

source.title: Verifiable LLM-Guided Focal SMT Solving for Quantified Arrays
source.excerpt: Evaluation on 1015 SMT-LIB instances across five logics under 1200s timeout (including LLM latency) shows that LinguaArray solves up to 69.1% of instances and increases solved-instance counts by 105%--397% over the corresponding backends.

cards.headline: Nonlinear dose-response effects of exercise interventions on post-stroke depression

source.title: Nonlinear dose-response effects of exercise interventions on post-stroke depression: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Moderate-dose exercise intervention, approximately 801 MET-min/week, was associated with a modest improvement in post-stroke depressive symptoms. These findings provide a reference for optimizing exercise dosage and informing individualized prescription strategies for patients with PSD.

cards.headline: ARBITRA: Robust Document-Level ATT&CK Extraction via Multi-Expert Argumentation

source.title: ARBITRA: Robust Document-Level ATT&CK Extraction via Multi-Expert Argumentation
source.excerpt: Under adversarial perturbations simulating conflicting TTP statements, cross-report contamination, and semantic poisoning, ARBITRA limits mean precision degradation to roughly half that of frontier-model baselines for a more robust extraction.

cards.headline: AI-based decision models for difficult airway assessment

source.title: AI-based decision models for difficult airway assessment: from research innovation to clinical implementation-a narrative review.
source.excerpt: Ultimately, bridging the translational gap requires rigorous, prospective multicenter validation demonstrating tangible patient safety improvements, rather than relying solely on algorithmic sophistication.

cards.headline: über das Diesseits und das Jenseits. Und sie fragen dich nach den Waisen.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:220
source.excerpt: ويسألونك -أيها النبي- عن اليتامى الذين مات آباؤهم وهم دون سن البلوغ كيف يتصرفون معهم في معاشهم وأموالهم؟ قل لهم: إصلاحكم لهم خير، فافعلوا الأنفع لهم دائمًا، وإن تخالطوهم في سائر شؤون المعاش فهم إخوانكم في الدين. وعلى الأخ أن يرعى مصلحة أخيه. والله يعلم المضيع لأموال اليتامى من الحريص على إصلاحها. ولو شاء الله لضيَّق وشقَّ عليكم بتحريم الخالطة. إن الله عزيز في ملكه، حكيم في خلقه وتدبيره وتشريعه.

cards.arabic: فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۗ وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْيَتَـٰمَىٰ ۖ قُلْ إِصْلَاحٌ لَّهُمْ خَيْرٌ ۖ وَإِن تُخَالِطُوهُمْ فَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْمُفْسِدَ مِنَ ٱلْمُصْلِحِ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَعْنَتَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
cards.translation: über das Diesseits und das Jenseits. Und sie fragen dich nach den Waisen. Sag: Ihre Lage zu verbessern ist besser. Und wenn ihr euch mit ihnen zusammentut, so sind sie eure Brüder. Allah weiß den Unheilstifter vom Heilstifter (zu unterscheiden). Und wenn Allah gewollt hätte, hätte Er euch wahrlich in Bedrängnis gebracht. Allah ist Allmächtig und Allweise.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Gradual Prohibition of Khamr (Alchoholic Drink): Imam Ahmad recorded that Abu Maysarah said that `Umar once said, "O Allah! Give us a clear ruling regarding Al-Khamr!"

cards.headline: Und heiratet Götzendienerinnen nicht, bevor sie glauben.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:221
source.excerpt: ولا تتزوجوا -أيها المسلمون- المشركات عابدات الأوثان، حتى يدخلن في الإسلام. واعلموا أنَّ امرأة مملوكةً لا مال لها ولا حسب، مؤمنةً بالله، خير من امرأة مشركة، وإن أعجبتكم المشركة الحرة. ولا تُزَوِّجوا نساءكم المؤمنات -إماء أو حرائر- للمشركين حتى يؤمنوا بالله ورسوله. واعلموا أن عبدًا مؤمنًا مع فقره، خير من مشرك.

cards.arabic: وَلَا تَنكِحُوا۟ ٱلْمُشْرِكَـٰتِ حَتَّىٰ يُؤْمِنَّ ۚ وَلَأَمَةٌ مُّؤْمِنَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِّن مُّشْرِكَةٍ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تُنكِحُوا۟ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ حَتَّىٰ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ ۚ وَلَعَبْدٌ مُّؤْمِنٌ خَيْرٌ مِّن مُّشْرِكٍ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكُمْ ۗ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَدْعُونَ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۖ وَيُبَيِّنُ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
cards.translation: Und heiratet Götzendienerinnen nicht, bevor sie glauben. Und eine gläubige Sklavin ist fürwahr besser als eine Götzendienerin, auch wenn diese euch gefallen sollte. Und verheiratet nicht (gläubige Frauen) mit Götzendienern, bevor sie glauben. Und ein gläubiger Sklave ist fürwahr besser als ein Götzendiener, auch wenn dieser euch gefallen sollte. Jene laden zum (Höllen)feuer ein. Allah aber lädt zum (Paradies)garten und zur Vergebung ein, mit Seiner Erlaubnis, und macht den Menschen Seine Zeichen klar, auf daß sie bedenken mögen.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Prohibition of marrying Mushrik Men and Women: Allah prohibited the believers from marrying Mushrik women who worship idols.

cards.headline: FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss

source.title: FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss
source.excerpt: These results suggest that parameter-derived relational supervision provides a stronger synthetic pre-training signal than label-based classification for transfer beyond recognition.

cards.headline: Clinical AI Beyond Development

source.title: Clinical AI Beyond Development: A Scoping Review of Deployment-Related Robustness, Algorithmovigilance, and Lifecycle Oversight.
source.excerpt: Post-development clinical AI evaluation remains a layered and emerging field rather than a mature monitoring literature. Direct live evidence is limited, concentrated in high-income settings, and weighted towards radiology. The findings should be interpreted as synthesis-informed rather than as empirically validated standards for lifecycle oversight.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence-guided engineering of precision ocular therapeutics

source.title: Artificial intelligence-guided engineering of precision ocular therapeutics.
source.excerpt: Rigorous experimental validation remains essential; artificial intelligence-nominated candidates and predictions must be tested empirically to confirm their safety, biological relevance, and therapeutic efficacy.

cards.headline: Diagnosing the Reference Gap

source.title: Diagnosing the Reference Gap: What Visual Scaffolds Can and Cannot Fix in Multimodal Reasoning
source.excerpt: These findings identify the reference gap as a bottleneck distinct from visual perception and show that constructing task-appropriate visual references can serve as a training-free visual skill for improving multimodal reasoning.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence-based automated scoring of the mouse grimace scale

source.title: Artificial intelligence-based automated scoring of the mouse grimace scale: a systematic review.
source.excerpt: Addressing these limitations will be critical to support the robust and reliable integration of automated grimace analysis into future pain research.

cards.headline: Neuro-ophthalmic complications of tuberculosis and its treatment

source.title: Neuro-ophthalmic complications of tuberculosis and its treatment: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: TB-related neuro-ophthalmic complications represent significant morbidity with identifiable risk factors. Visual evoked potentials offer superior subclinical detection and early intervention improves visual outcomes. Screening protocols targeting high-risk populations are recommended.

cards.headline: Retaining Repair Hypotheses for Cost-Aware Execution

source.title: Retaining Repair Hypotheses for Cost-Aware Execution
source.excerpt: These results support retaining alternatives to a generated repair and evaluating diagnostic selection together with repair weighting and learning from execution.

cards.headline: Efficacy and safety of parathyroid hormone analogs therapy on hypoparathyroidism

source.title: Efficacy and safety of parathyroid hormone analogs therapy on hypoparathyroidism: a meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: In addition to the comparable control of serum calcium and serum phosphorus levels to conventional therapy, limited data indicate that PTH analogs treatment may be better in regulating the serum vitamin D and maintaining the eGFR for patients with HypoPTH. PTH analogs therapy also improves patients' HRQoL.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in congenital heart surgery

source.title: Artificial intelligence in congenital heart surgery: a scoping review and primer for surgeons.
source.excerpt: AI applications in CHS are rapidly expanding across diverse domains, with early studies showing encouraging potential to support diagnostics, guide surgical decision-making, and improve perioperative outcomes. However, most models remain in the preliminary stage with limited external validation.

cards.headline: Safe Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning

source.title: Safe Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning: Zero Constraint Violation and Primal-Averaging Convergence
source.excerpt: To our knowledge, we provide the first sample-efficient MORL algorithms that guarantee safety for every executed policy.

cards.headline: Performance of Automatic Speech Analysis in Detecting Depression

source.title: Performance of Automatic Speech Analysis in Detecting Depression: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
source.excerpt: ASA shows promise as a method for detecting depression, though its readiness for clinical application as a standalone tool remains limited. At present, it should be regarded as a complementary method, with potential applications across diverse contexts.

cards.headline: The association between the triglyceride-glucose index and diabetic peripheral neuropathy

source.title: The association between the triglyceride-glucose index and diabetic peripheral neuropathy: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Elevated TyG levels are associated with an increased risk of DPN in patients with T2DM. However, the causal relationship requires further validation. These findings may serve as a reference for clinical screening of DPN risk.

cards.headline: SymKL: A Unified Representation-Space Measure of Signal Degradation

source.excerpt: Code will be made publicly available after the review process.

cards.headline: Efficacy of house dust mite allergen immunotherapy in allergic rhinitis

source.title: Efficacy of house dust mite allergen immunotherapy in allergic rhinitis: a network meta-analysis based on component-resolved classification.
source.excerpt: Reported immunologic and compositional profiles of HDM-AIT preparations were associated with variability in trial-level efficacy estimates. These findings support product-level molecular characterization and direct comparative studies as priorities for future precision AIT.

cards.headline: Sie fragen dich nach der Monatsblutung. Sag: Sie ist ein Leiden.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:222
source.excerpt: ويسألونك عن الحيض -وهو الدم الذي يسيل من أرحام النساء جِبِلَّة في أوقات مخصوصة-، قل لهم -أيها النبي-: هو أذى مستقذر يضر من يَقْرَبُه، فاجتنبوا جماع النساء مدة الحيض حتى ينقطع الدم، فإذا انقطع الدم، واغتسلن، فجامعوهن في الموضع الذي أحلَّه الله لكم، وهو القبل لا الدبر. إن الله يحب عباده المكثرين من الاستغفار والتوبة، ويحب عباده المتطهرين الذين يبتعدون عن الفواحش والأقذار.

cards.arabic: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْمَحِيضِ ۖ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى فَٱعْتَزِلُوا۟ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فِى ٱلْمَحِيضِ ۖ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَطْهُرْنَ ۖ فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلتَّوَّٰبِينَ وَيُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
cards.translation: Sie fragen dich nach der Monatsblutung. Sag: Sie ist ein Leiden. So haltet euch von den Frauen während der Monatsblutung fern, und kommt ihnen nicht nahe, bis sie rein sind. Wenn sie sich dann gereinigt haben, so kommt zu ihnen, wie Allah es euch geboten hat. Allah liebt die Reumütigen, und Er liebt die, die sich rein halten.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Sexual Intercourse with Menstruating Women is prohibited: Imam Ahmad recorded that Anas said that the Jews used to avoid their menstruating women, they would not eat, or even mingle with them in the house.

cards.headline: Eure Frauen sind euch ein Saatfeld. So kommt zu eurem Saatfeld, wann und wie ihr wollt.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:223
source.excerpt: نساؤكم موضع زرع لكم، تضعون النطفة في أرحامهن، فَيَخْرج منها الأولاد بمشيئة الله، فجامعوهن في محل الجماع فقط، وهو القبل بأي كيفية شئتم، وقَدِّموا لأنفسكم أعمالا صالحة بمراعاة أوامر الله، وخافوا الله، واعلموا أنكم ملاقوه للحساب يوم القيامة. وبشِّر المؤمنين -أيها النبي- بما يفرحهم ويسرُّهم من حسن الجزاء في الآخرة.

cards.arabic: نِسَآؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَّكُمْ فَأْتُوا۟ حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّىٰ شِئْتُمْ ۖ وَقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّكُم مُّلَـٰقُوهُ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
cards.translation: Eure Frauen sind euch ein Saatfeld. So kommt zu eurem Saatfeld, wann und wie ihr wollt. Doch schickt (Gutes) für euch selbst voraus. Und fürchtet Allah und wißt, daß ihr Ihm begegnen werdet. Und verkünde den Gläubigen frohe Botschaft.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Sexual Intercourse with Menstruating Women is prohibited: Imam Ahmad recorded that Anas said that the Jews used to avoid their menstruating women, they would not eat, or even mingle with them in the house.
